svg.title: Figure 37.3 · The November run: every task but chat improved
svg.desc: Seven lines of held-out loss divided by step-0 loss over 12,500 steps of eight batches. Chat rises slowly from 1.02 at step 625 to 1.09 at step 12,500; reading ends at 0.36, VQA 0.50, captions 0.38, Hindi speech 0.15, English speech 0.05, intents 0.02. The dashed score falls to 0.365; the kept checkpoint is step 9,375, where the score is 0.3643 and chat 1.087.
svg.text: Held-out loss ÷ step-0 loss, per task, in the November run
ckpt_omni_curve.csv · 8 batches per step, lr 2.5e-5, chat weight 0.25 · lower is better
chat: 1.02 at the first evaluation, 1.09 at the last
